name: Aibi Pocket Robot
description: A small, pocket-sized AI companion from Living.AI — the same company behind EMO, elsewhere in this directory — with a screen face, front camera for face recognition, and a rotating body that docks on a round charging base. Works out of the box without an app; the app is only needed to register faces and enable ChatGPT-based conversation.

sourcing: Verified against Living.AI's own official site (living.ai/aibi/ and its Aibi Pocket product page), a CB Insights company profile for Living.AI's HQ/founding, the "AIBI Pocket" companion app's listing on Google Play, and a hands-on account from the enthusiast forum robotsaroundthehouse.com. No reputable tech-press coverage (The Verge, Engadget, CNET, Tom's Guide) was found for this product specifically. Dimensions, weight, screen resolution, camera resolution, and battery life are not published by Living.AI and are marked as such rather than estimated; a promotional blog's battery-life and price figures conflict sharply with the manufacturer's own price and are flagged as unreliable rather than used. Shipping-delay reports come from a single enthusiast forum thread, not a manufacturer statement. Search results also surfaced unrelated products and companies using the name "Aibi" (a fintech app, generic marketplace listings); this page covers only the screen-faced companion robot matching the photo, made by Living.AI.

pricing.summary: $249 on Living.AI's own store, also listed on Amazon and eBay through third-party resellers, as a one-time purchase with no subscription. A separate promotional blog cites $599.99–$680, which conflicts sharply with the manufacturer's own price and should be treated as unreliable/disputed.

editorial.heading: Insights
editorial.body: A separate promotional blog publishes battery-life and price figures for Aibi Pocket, but its cited price ($599–680) is so far off Living.AI's own $249 listing that it reads as unreliable rather than corroborating — a spec discrepancy worth flagging for anyone comparison shopping.

firmwareCommunity.note: Aibi Pocket Robot has not released a public SDK, firmware repo, or developer API. Not currently listed in Builds & Mods.
